Removed these string columns from X, keeping only numeric features plus 'city' (which gets converted to numeric codes in cell 3).

Both fixes preserved the original intent of the code - the notebook now successfully loads data, processes categorical variables, and trains a linear regression model on housing price predictions without any crashes.
